Title: Show HN: AI Hub – Open Access Lesson Plans for Teaching Students about AI
Article title: AI Hub: Open Access Resources
Description: Open-access resources from six nonprofits, helping educators in Allegheny and Westmoreland counties teach students about AI.
HN text: The AI Hub provides 91 curated lesson plans teaching middle and high school students about AI - how it works, what the risks and benefits of AI are, and how it is impacting society. These activities come from six different nonprofit organizations that are building educational resources for classrooms. Our nonprofit worked with 16 different teachers to comb through more than 200 different resources, with the teachers vetting these resources to find the best resources for their classrooms.
